text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I go to the racecourse to
watch
some races for research...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can do it! That's it! You're almost
there!
Don't be scared!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! Stay at it! The finish line
is right in
front of you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Huh... Oh, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Apologies for my unseemly
behavior.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I just can't contain my excitement once
they
round the fourth corner.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's a moment when the stakes are so
high that a
runner's entire demeanor
changes. Do you know
what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I just can't resist that thrill!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's... Ahem. Sorry, I'm doing it again.
That's
enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She says that, but she looks like she
hasn't even
scratched the surface of this
topic.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Really?
choice_data_list: Well, I've got work to do, so I sh...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?! I know it's an important
time for
you and your trainee, so you
must be busy...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Well, if you say so!
choice_data_list: Today was my day off to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I know! Talking is nice and all,
but a chat
over
lunch would be even better, don't
you think?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's a spot nearby that I've
always
wanted to try out...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... It's such an honor to be able to
chat with
you like this, just the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: So, about the race earlier...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! I know just what you mean! It's
so
encouraging to see them chasing after
their
dreams with all they have!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But it's the voices of all the fans
cheering them on
that keeps driving
them forward...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it like that, races really
do bring
people together, don't they?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
On that note, last year's races were
also...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Derby! The Derby is the best! Of
course, the G1 races are all amazing and
deserve every bit of
respect they
receive.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But I have a special attachment to the
Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I watch it every year without
fail!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What?! How did it get so late already?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Um...
choice_data_list: Night fell before we even knew it...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the students, we don't exactly
have a
curfew, so...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind staying out a little
longer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so we move to another shop, where
we
continue to talk passionately about
racing.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I... can't believe it's already morning...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... I'm sorry for keeping you out
like this.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: But, well...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I had so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In truth, from the time we first met, I
could tell
you were also passionate
about Umamusume and
racing...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's great to be able to talk in depth
about this
with someone! I had a
wonderful time, hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If it's okay with you, let's do this again
sometime!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but we probably shouldn't stay up
all night
next time!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the tiredness creeping up on
me...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaawn...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We make our way back to the academy,
stifling
our yawns as we go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It feels like my friendship with Tazuna
has grown
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, of course! It's an important
time in your
trainee's career right
now—you must be busy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Um... Well, I'll be off,
then. I'll see you
around at
the academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tazuna and I go our separate
ways...
